title: One Vector or Many? Clustered Optimal-Transport Steering under Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.40055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization.   We prove an identity: whatever the plan, the displacements averaged with the cluster sizes as weights equal DiM, so a clustered map can differ from DiM only for tokens whose routing weights depart from the cluster sizes. translated_title: 一个向量还是多个向量？量化条件下的聚类最优传输引导
translated_abstract: 激活引导通过在推理时编辑语言模型的隐藏状态来改变模型的生成结果。其最常见的形式是向每个隐藏状态添加一个向量，即类别均值之差（DiM）。CHaRS（概念异质性感知表征引导）则采用最优传输：通过熵正则化的传输方案将两个类别的簇两两配对，每个隐藏状态沿簇位移的混合方向移动，其权重偏向距其最近的簇。我们在Gemma-2-2B和Granite-3.1-2B上研究了这类聚类最优传输映射在毒性缓解任务中的表现，并探究该传输方案相较于DiM的额外贡献，以及这种贡献能否在INT8和NF4量化下得以保留。我们证明了一个恒等式：无论传输方案如何，以簇大小为权重对位移取加权平均都等于DiM，因此聚类映射只有在词元的路由权重偏离簇大小时才会与DiM产生差异。在CHaRS的实验协议下，这些权重与簇大小保持接近，且CHaRS在统计上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究证明聚类最优传输引导方法的位移按簇大小加权平均后恒等于单向量DiM方法，其额外效果仅来自路由权重偏离簇大小的词元，且这种增益在INT8和NF4量化下难以保持。
